# THE TESTS THAT ARE ALREADY RED, WRITTEN DOWN SO NEW RED STILL MEANS SOMETHING.
#
# A suite with fifteen permanent failures is a suite nobody reads, and the
# sixteenth failure — the one somebody just caused — arrives invisible. So the
# known ones are listed here by name and skipped, which turns the full run back
# into a signal: red means this change did it.
#
# THIS FILE IS THE DEBT, AND IT IS A DIFF. Every line is a test somebody owes a
# fix for. Adding a line is allowed and sometimes right, but it is a reviewable
# line in the same pull request as the reason, never something a passing build
# quietly acquired. SIZE-BUDGET carries the same rule for bytes.
#
# One name per line. Matched as a whole Go test name against the full run in
# .github/workflows/ci-full.yml. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
#
# Seeded from the list in CLAUDE.md (verified failing on a clean macOS tree,
# 2026-08-26), then trued up against the first real Linux run on 2026-08-31
# (actions/runs/33414121900) — which named the four cmd/harness-design tests
# CLAUDE.md could not spell, and found six more nobody was tracking.

# Fail on a clean tree.
TestHarnessEntriesFromStore
TestSettingsSheetIsOneCalmColumnAtEveryWidth
TestSettingsNavigatesAndEditsEveryKindAndPersists
TestSettingsRefusesToFightTheEnvironment
TestRegistryCoversEveryUserFacingEnvironmentPin
TestEveryGoroutineInTheGuardedTreeIsGuarded
TestEveryLockInTheGuardedTreeUnlocksFromADefer
TestEveryMessageWriteUsesThreadPost

# Fails where the temp path is too long for a unix socket. Green on Linux with a
# short TMPDIR, so this line may well be removable — check before trusting it.
TestTheSocketMovesWithTheStateRoot

# Flake under full-suite load; pass alone. Rerun in isolation before believing a
# failure here.
TestOnlyADesignsOwnThreadCarriesTheReviseVerb
TestInterruptedTurnDoesNotWakeOnTheNoteItDrained

# The four cmd/harness-design tests, finally named by the Linux run. CLAUDE.md
# had only been able to say "four cmd/harness-design tests".
TestTheGuidesRender
TestReviewerCarriesTheWholeLaw
TestBothBriefsSayTheSyntaxIsASCII
TestTheReviewerBriefCarriesBothDuties

# Fails on macOS AND Linux — a clean-tree red on every platform that nobody had
# written down anywhere before 2026-08-31. Owed a real fix, not just this line.
TestTheEnginesStandingStoreAnswersOverTheWire

# Fail on the Linux CI runner and PASS on a clean macOS tree (each re-run
# locally on 2026-08-31 to confirm). Environment-shaped: whoever picks one up
# should reproduce on Linux first.
TestTickWalksTheItemsAndWritesAWakeLine
TestTickLeavesQuietlyWhenAWindowIsAlreadyKeepingWatch
TestRenderTerrainStaysUnderTheCap
TestTheFixedPrefixStaysUnderItsBudget
TestATransientClaimFailureDoesNotEndDispatchForever

# From the second Linux run (2026-08-31, the first in which internal/tui3 ever
# survived to report): red on the Linux runner, passes on a clean macOS tree.
TestAPathInsideACorrectionIsADoor
